backcard_card_name: SS4 Son Goku & SS4 Vegeta, In It Together
backcard_card_text:
[Permanent] You can use your mono-red Rest Mode 《Saiyan》 cards in combos.
[Permanent] Your <Gogeta : GT> cards can attack your opponent's Battle Cards in Active Mode, and when your <Gogeta : GT> cards attack your opponent's Battle Cards, your opponent skips their Defense Step.
[Auto][Once per turn] When you activate [Union-Fusion], this card gains <Gogeta : GT> for the turn.
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card, then play up to 1 red 《Saiyan》 card with an energy cost of 1 from your hand in Rest Mode.
card_set: Zenkai Series Dawn of The Z-Legends [BT18]
card_text:
[Permanent] You can use your mono-red Rest Mode 《Saiyan》 cards in combos.
[Auto][Once per turn] When you use a card in a combo, look at up to 3 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 red 《Saiyan》 card or 1 red Unison with a specified cost of 2 among them to your hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less or you have 2 or more energy and both <Son Goku : GT> and <Vegeta : GT> cards in your Z-Energy : You may draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
